'''Crane droids'''<ref name="Freedom" /> also known as '''cargo lifter droids'''<ref name="Remnants">{{WEGCite|story=Remnants of the Empire (adventure)|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)}}</ref> were industrial [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. They were employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on their [[Imperial mining complex|mobile mining operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]] under the command of [[Control (droid)|Control]], a [[Terreene Brainiac]] class of [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]].<ref name="Freedom" /> One model of crane droid was the [[2V9 cargo lifter droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="Remnants" />
